english.note: Use 結果 as the all-purpose noun for an outcome or consequence.

exampleSentences.english: The result of this exam is pretty good.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 git3 gwo2 gei2 hou2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the result or outcome caused by something.

exampleSentences.english: The effect of this decision was something nobody expected.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個決定最後嘅結果，大家都估唔到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 gwo2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 gu2 m4 dou2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the final result of a series of events or actions.

exampleSentences.english: The culmination of all our efforts was finally winning the championship.
exampleSentences.traditional: 一連串努力嘅結果，就係我哋終於攞到冠軍。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jat1 lin4 cyun3 nou5 lik6 ge3 git3 gwo2 zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 gun1 gwan1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the result or outcome of an event or process.

exampleSentences.english: The outcome of this project is quite good.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次個計劃嘅結果幾理想。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 git3 gwo2 gei2 lei5 soeng2

english.note: Use 結果 when end means the result or outcome of events or actions.

exampleSentences.english: In the end, the result is still your choice.
exampleSentences.traditional: 最後嘅結果都係你自己揀。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 nei5 zi6 gei2 gaan2
